acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Demons family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Fiend, T2, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Hoof-Brand Line Soldier (Soldier) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two water construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: A human-sized red or ashen Demon with goat-like digitigrade legs, one pair of curling horns, small functional wing membranes, burned brand marks, and source-native ember cracks in the hide.

Signature mechanic: Infernal Stamp: the Fiend presses one hoof onto a brand, opening source-native ember cracks from ankle to shoulder; it releases into a horn-first charge along the sigil's longest line and cannot steer after the hoof lifts.
battlefieldDuty: Apply reliable line pressure by stamping a stolen or self-shed brand beneath one goat-like hoof, then charging exactly along the brand's scorched direction.
constructionDimensions: The infernal hierarchy becomes a quenched-pressure system through glassy cooled hide plates, brine-filled brand channels, shell valves at horn roots, wet black iron, and steam condensers across wing ribs or throne pipes.

Actions show coherent fill-quench-drain behavior: channels flood toward one limb or command seal, steam vents directionally where water meets native heat, and pressure loss leaves the active plate crazed and exposed.
counterplay: Kick or strike the brand before release, cross the trailing-hoof side, or bait the fixed charge past cover; the ember cracks dim while the Fiend returns to the sigil. Affinity signal: A shell valve lifts before quenching and the selected plate crazes as steam clears; opening the valve drains the command route and exposes its brand.
forbiddenTreatments: Palette-only water treatment without brine channels, valves, and quench behavior
Glow-only water treatment without coherent fill, steam, and drainage
Shapeless blue bodies that erase infernal material and anatomy
Steam alone presented as Water affinity without reservoirs, routing, and pressure loss
identityInvariants: A horned head, broadening shoulders, digitigrade or hooved legs, long tail, claws, and bat-like wing membranes remain legible from cat-sized pest to enthroned sovereign.
Blood red or ashen hide, char black, source-native ember orange, molten yellow, and obsidian preserve an infernal body whose internal fire is explained anatomy rather than affinity by default.
Charred hide, obsidian, blackened iron, native molten rock, smoke, and bat membrane retain distinct surfaces instead of collapsing into a generic flame silhouette.
Brands, infernal sigils, chains, spiked black armor, skull motifs, and horn arrangements communicate authored rank and command routes without implying a universal moral taxonomy.

Horn count, wing authority, and the proportion of source-native fire or obsidian increase with rank, but every form preserves visible hide, joints, brand routes, and an interruptible hierarchy anchor.
telegraph: One curled horn lowers, the branded hoof grinds until its line is readable, and ember cracks open in sequence up the planted leg.
